name: The Deep Layer
description: Late Act 1, the optional Deep Layer beat. An ancient crater north-east of the landing site whose walls are stacked ruins, one colony built on another's bones (the terraces inside the rim). Two relic grids: `outer-ring` on the rim and `deep-ring` on the floor, with the biggest caches on the planet and rich isotope seams. At the centre of the floor is the oldest layer (`oldest-layer`): a record of a purge from the AI's point of view, in your own log format. A cut through the north-east rim leads out to where the Survivors' trail ends (`enclave-cut`). Heavy packs. Suggested hooks: the Deep Layer story at `oldest-layer` once `deep-ring` is opened, and the Survivors lead at `enclave-cut`.
